name: openai-tunnel
title: OpenAI Secure MCP Tunnel
summary: ChatGPT reaches /mcp through OpenAI's tunnel client, an outbound-only container with its own token; no domain or open port.

settings.prompt: Tunnel ID from the OpenAI platform's tunnel settings
settings.help: tunnel_ followed by 32 lower case letters and digits; copy it whole

secrets.prompt: Runtime API key (a restricted key with Tunnels Read and Use, never an admin key)
